description: This file defines the interface `ThingBuilder` in Java for constructing immutable `Thing` objects using a fluent builder pattern. It includes nested interfaces `FromScratch` and `FromCopy` for creating new `Thing` instances or copying existing ones with modifications, mainly focusing on setting properties, permissions, attributes, features, lifecycle, revision, and associated metadata.

classes.name: ThingBuilder
classes.description: Primary interface providing builder methods for creating and modifying instances of `Thing`. Contains nested interfaces for different modes of building, such as from scratch or from an existing instance.

classes.name: ThingBuilder.FromScratch
classes.description: A builder interface for constructing a new `Thing` instance from scratch with a fluent API to set various properties.

classes.name: ThingBuilder.FromCopy
classes.description: A builder interface for creating a modified copy of an existing `Thing` with a fluent API.

methods.name: generateRandomThingId
methods.description: Generates a random `ThingId` without namespace, marked as deprecated in favor of `generateRandomTypedThingId()`.

methods.name: generateRandomTypedThingId
methods.description: Generates a random `ThingId` with a namespace.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the given revision to this builder. Overloaded methods allow setting revision with a `Predicate<ThingRevision>` or a long value, with default implementations for convenience.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the modified timestamp with optional predicate filtering. Can accept an `Instant` or null.

methods.name: setCreated
methods.description: Sets the created timestamp with optional predicate filtering. Can accept an `Instant` or null. Available since version 1.2.0.

methods.name: setMetadata
methods.description: Sets the metadata with optional predicate filtering. Can accept a `Metadata` object or null. Available since version 1.2.0.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the Thing ID, either as a String or `ThingId`, with predicate filtering. Deprecated version accepting String is marked as deprecated in favor of the typed `ThingId` version.

methods.name: setGeneratedId
methods.description: Sets a generated Thing ID, allowing predicate filtering.
